content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the modification of the input arguments (specifically arrays) passed to the constructors of the `Manager` and `ReadPreference` classes. When these arrays were mutated (e.g., converted from arrays to objects), the changes were reflected in the original arrays provided by the caller, leading to unintended side effects. This behavior was particularly problematic when the input arrays were immutable due to OPcache, which could result in a crash. The patch addresses this by ensuring that the input arguments are separated before any modifications are made, preventing any unintended side effects on the original data.
